identityRule: Sorted path + NUL + lowercase SHA256 + newline. content/puzzles.json uses the unchanged exact base-commit blob; all other deliverable inputs use current worktree bytes.
unchangedContent: content/puzzles.json remains the committed base blob; unrelated worktree campaign edits are excluded.
reviewSupplements: Original owning review/raw evidence, implementation receipt and prior terminal publication receipts may accompany. Review-only future verdict/receipts are not inputs to their own approval.
